## Source: amazon-inspector (4b829053417a14305f80204983289f120f71abd2472785cd4e2adfe095599003)
The package name 'reqparser' resembles common HTTP client / parsing library names in the Python ecosystem, a shape frequently used by typosquat lures. The tarball contains 3 files, and no concrete installer-harm behavior (credential read, environment scraping, network exfiltration, install-time fetch-and-execute, lifecycle-script exec) could be corroborated in this record. Automated deep tracing did not produce reviewable output for this artifact.

## Source: kam193 (982923c14e644e82a839621d37715fd123568fc378aed45b6afa6247bc0b5054)
During the module import, the package starts an infostealer. It exfiltrates data from crypto currency wallets and web browsers, ensures persistence and installs further malware.
